title: Fair care without excessive restraint

captions.physics: Sharing household work according to capacity
captions.energy: Increasing care beyond the agreed measure

meaning: Your domestic agreement preserves support when growing care becomes a visible shared load instead of calm requiring endless endurance of its additions.
text: You can arrange participation through clear agreements: considering actual work, sharing manageable tasks and noticing decisions’ consequences. Justice in the physical position of Muladhara describes this fairness in action. The Empress in energy tests your footing through increasing care without always noticing both people’s limits. Strength in emotions gently contains irritation. Even a fair initial agreement may therefore become demanding when pleasant jobs are continually added and objections feel awkward. Additions look like kindness while requiring entirely real time and effort.

For example, you divide dinner preparation. Home baking, special presentation and a compulsory dessert later join ordinary food, but the division remains unchanged. **New care needs new, clear agreement about its scale.** Recognising this need not accuse anyone of insufficient generosity. Gentleness helps discuss actual participation instead of silently carrying expanded work so your shared home can continue looking warm and attentive.

The difficulty is accepting each addition as a minor daily exception. Dissatisfaction stays invisible until one request feels like the last straw. The other may not know how much has accumulated. An agreement supports you more dependably when it includes the actual amount and allows care to be recognised as enough in time, without proving love through restraint before every new expression of it. Shared kindness can then remain manageable for both.
